source_quote: The Zone 1 price also includes pieces mailed with different 3-digit O/D pairs, whose centroids are up to 50 miles in distance.
notes: DMM 608.9.4.2; zone 1 also covers any pair within the same 3-digit ZIP prefix. Band edges are 'about' the stated radius.

notes: Open-ended. USPS zone 9 is not a distance band: it covers Palau, Micronesia and the Marshall Islands and is excluded from the dashboard mapping.
